annotations.description: Annotations holds extensible metadata (serialized to receipts).

error.description: Error message if status is failed.

id.description: ID is the unique identifier (typically relative target path or package name).

layer.description: Layer is the repository layer (base, team, personal).

retry.description: Retry is the retry policy for this node (nil = no retry).

slots.description: Input slots for this node (name -> value)

timestamp.description: Timestamp is when this action completed.

slot_value.description: A slot value - either immediate or a promise (reference to another node)

field.description: Field is the field name to access on the proxy item.

gather_ref.description: GatherRef is the gather node ID for proxy resolution.

immediate.description: Immediate is the direct value (any type, known at analysis time).

node_ref.description: NodeRef is the ID of the node that produces this value (promise).

slot.description: Slot is which output slot of the referenced node (empty = default output).
